{"subject":"Quick hello from Elena","body":"Hi there,

I've been following Cursor from the sidelines and wanted to say hello. It's great to see how many developers talk about it in their day-to-day work.

I'd love to hear what you're focused on over the next few months and where the team is spending its energy. If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call at whatever time suits you. No agenda beyond catching up.

Wishing you and the team a strong quarter.

Best,
Elena"}
